remaining_gaps: Clause 1 directs the Associated Fishing Tackle Manufacturers to amend its bylaws 'as soon as practicable'. No held record shows whether or when the bylaws were amended, and no held source shows the repeal of Title I extinguished that duty. A source showing the amendment (or the Administrator's acceptance of it) is needed to give the command its own end.

Clause 1 creates a Planning and Fair Practice Agency (a five-member committee elected by the industry plus three non-voting members appointed by the Administrator). No held record shows its constitution, the Administrator's appointments, or its dissolution, and S.J. Res. 113 section 2 (repeal of code approval and enforcement provisions) does not on its face dissolve it. Needed: a source for the committee's creation or end, or a held reason it fell with the code.

Clause 1 creates a code authority acting as a Planning and Fair Practice Agency (five elected industry members plus three non-voting members appointed by the Administrator). No held record shows its constitution, the Administrator's appointments, or its dissolution, and S.J. Res. 113 section 2 does not on its face dissolve it. Needed: a source for the code authority's creation or end, or a held reason it fell with the code.

Clause 1 directs the Government members of the Graphic Arts Code Authority to give attention to minors' newspaper work and report to the President within sixty days (about April 25, 1934). No held record shows the report, its date, or any ending of the direction; the deadline is not an end, and no held source shows the repeal extinguished it.

The proviso's sixty-day review window runs from the effective date of Subchapter II-C, which neither the order nor any held source states. Without it the lapse of the contingent stay power cannot be dated, and no held record shows whether a finding or stay was ever made. Needed: the effective date of Subchapter II-C (the Subchapter text or a held notice of its effective date) and any record of a review under the proviso.

Needed: the effective date of Subchapter II-B (the Subchapter text or a held notice of its effective date) and any record of a review under the proviso.
